ideas.title: Picking a First DMR Handheld: AnyTone, Ailunce and Alinco Side by Side
ideas.why_now: A listener-style question about which DMR radio to buy is circulating this week, and handhelds and repeater content are among the strongest performers for us and for other channels.
ideas.angle: Fits the OPEN YouTube slot on 2026-11-12. Compare the three brands on price, codeplug programming, talkgroup setup and real check-ins on local Michigan repeaters. Brand names and prices go in the title, with no question mark, because those patterns test best on this channel.

ideas.title: Open Firmware on HF Rigs: Xiegu X6100 and sBitx V3 Get Hacker Upgrades
ideas.why_now: New open-source firmware for the Xiegu X6100 just added birdie calibration, sBitx owners are writing their own GPS time and grid tools, and ham radio is showing up at hacker conferences this fall.
ideas.angle: Record 2026-11-03, release in the OPEN podcast slot 2026-11-05. A conversation episode on why tinkering with radio firmware is the modern version of homebrew: what changes on the X6100, what new sBitx users are building, and how a newcomer can try it without bricking a rig. New angle vs our earlier native FT8 on the X6100 video: this is about community firmware, not the factory feature.

ideas.title: Building a Club Meshtastic Network in Michigan: Nodes, Range and What Worked
ideas.why_now: Off-grid and mesh talk is everywhere this fall, emergency comms discussion is rising, and mesh videos are breaking out at a high rate on other channels while we have barely touched it.
ideas.angle: Fits the OPEN YouTube slot on 2026-11-19. Set up a few nodes with club members, test range across town, and show how mesh complements (not replaces) ham radio. Keep it hands-on and beginner friendly, with node prices in the title.

ideas.title: The New POTA Website Walkthrough With Mike W8MSC: Spotting, Logs and New Features
ideas.why_now: The new POTA site has been adding features steadily based on user feedback, and a clear tour shows activators and hunters what changed and that the organization is listening.
ideas.angle: Fits the OPEN YouTube slot on 2026-12-10. Frame it as a software walkthrough first (screen recording plus Mike explaining the why behind each feature), not a park trip. Exception note: POTA videos underperform here, but free-app and logging walkthroughs are breaking out elsewhere, so lead with the software.

ideas.title: Radioddity HF-010 vs SpoolTenna Ultra: Vertical or EFHW for Portable 20m
ideas.why_now: Antenna talk is rising in the community, including a popular question about whether a 20m vertical or an end-fed half wave is the better first portable antenna, and we already own both.
ideas.angle: Fits the OPEN YouTube slot on 2026-12-17. Same location, same radio, same hour: swap antennas and compare FT8 reports and setup time. New angle vs our earlier single-product reviews: a direct head to head that answers the vertical vs EFHW question.

ideas.title: Name That Signal: What Is This on the Waterfall?
ideas.why_now: SDR and scanning is by far the fastest rising discussion topic right now, and a weekly ham challenge this month is all about finding and identifying an unknown signal.
ideas.angle: A recurring Shorts series posted between the long-form slots (start after the 2026-11-12 video). Show a waterfall clip, pause, then reveal the mode and how we identified it. New angle vs earlier SDR pitches: no setup tutorial, just quick signal identification that works as a repeatable format.

ideas.title: Icom Keeps Filing: Two More UHF Digital Radios Hit the FCC
ideas.why_now: Icom filed two additional UHF digital transceivers on 2026-10-28 and 2026-10-30, after the batch we already discussed, plus new Wouxun GMRS filings.
ideas.angle: Quick Short posted the week of the 2026-11-05 podcast, outside the long-form slot plan. New angle vs the earlier filing pitches: the update on the latest filings and what a run of this many digital transceivers could mean, with a clear note that a filing is not a product yet. Tease it in the 2026-12-03 Radios of the Year episode.
